primary_R.period_basis: SEDAC documentation (bundled in the ZIP): UHI_all_averaged = cluster-mean composite averaged over 2003-2018; the shapefile has one value per cluster and no year/month fields

ontology_decision: C: cluster-level response requiring aggregation of the UCDB centres inside a cluster (units = YCEO clusters)
why_not_LOCKED: Only 2,192 cluster units (2,459 of 10,915 UCDB cities, 22.5%) are defensibly matchable; 5,848 sample cities have no substantive YCEO cluster (YCEO uses fixed Natural Earth 1:10m urban polygons, which omit most small GHSL centres). This is below the 3,000-city minimum pre-registered in 1005-6 (section 5), which would downgrade the primary claim to 'underpowered' before any model is fit.

Matching selection is strong: matched cities are larger (SMD of log10 population = 1.03; log10 built-up = 1.28) and older (YOB median 1975 vs 1985, SMD = -0.56; share urbanized after 1975 = 35% vs 59%). Asia drops from 57.5% to 47.0% of the sample, South America and North America roughly double their share, Oceania has 28 cities. Bias is not 'manageable' without an explicit PI-approved handling rule.
Footprint ontologies differ: median IoU of clean 1:1 pairs is 0.39, only 944 strict pairs reach IoU>=0.5; R is measured within the YCEO polygon while S/H are measured within the GHSL polygon.
Response period (2003-2018) overlaps H and precedes S(2020): predictive-association only (unchanged from 1005-6).
what_is_resolved: ZIP valid, shapefile complete (.shp .shx .dbf .prj + cpg/sbn/sbx/fix), 10,136 polygons, EPSG:4326, 0 invalid/empty/duplicate geometries
Primary and secondary R fields exist as single, unambiguous columns; 98.6% valid; no -999 or sentinel values

Documentation bundled in the ZIP answers 1005-6 open questions: Natural Earth 1:10m urban extents (not Landscan), ESA CCI land cover, rural reference = non-urban non-water pixels within the cluster with elevation within 50 m of the urban median, Terra+Aqua combined for day/night, summer defined by hemisphere (JJA north, DJF south), v4 has 10,136 clusters, MODIS LST error <=3 C
No raster processing and no further research data are needed
decision_needed_from_PI: Accept a reduced primary sample (~2,200 cluster units) and amend the 3,000 threshold, or define a looser primary rule
Choose bias handling: pre-registered inverse-probability reweighting / size-and-region-stratified analysis / restriction to common-support
Confirm cluster-level S/H aggregation as the primary unit (single-city clusters are the majority, 93%)
